# Shared setup for the five decks + cheat sheet (labs carry their own inline copy so each lab stays a standalone script).
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(mice); library(naniar) })
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 16))
p <- c("data/ncd_missing.csv", "../data/ncd_missing.csv", "../../data/ncd_missing.csv"); p <- p[file.exists(p)][1]
ncd <- read_csv(p, show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(sex = factor(sex), education = factor(education, levels = c("None", "Primary", "Secondary+")))
dat <- ncd |> select(-id)                          # the id must not enter the imputation model
col_blue <- "#3498db"; col_red <- "#e74c3c"; col_navy <- "#2c3e50"; col_green <- "#27ae60"

chunks.code:
ini <- mice(dat, maxit = 0, printFlag = FALSE)
ini$method

dat2 <- dat |> mutate(smoker = factor(smoker, labels = c("No", "Yes")))
imp <- mice(dat2, m = 20, maxit = 10, seed = 2038, printFlag = FALSE)
imp$method

fit <- with(imp, lm(sbp ~ age + sex + bmi + smoker + activity))
pooled <- pool(fit)
summary(pooled, conf.int = TRUE)[, c("term", "estimate", "std.error", "df", "conf.low", "conf.high")] |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

m_cc <- lm(sbp ~ age + sex + bmi + smoker + activity, data = dat)
s <- summary(pooled, conf.int = TRUE)
round(rbind(complete_case = summary(m_cc)$coefficients["bmi", 1:2], multiple_imputation = unlist(s[s$term == "bmi", c("estimate", "std.error")])), 3)
